runtime_evidence_gaps: No runtime evidence bundle was available within the 2-hour freshness window. Profitability, canary or live-readiness claims are therefore withheld.
Shadow window metrics (opportunities, eligible_opportunities, trades, net_profit, profit_factor) are absent for all strategies.
Execution failure and signal_skip rates are unknown without a fresh evidence file.
Per-chain cost breakdowns (Solana priority fees, EVM gas, slippage) are unverified at this cycle.

proposals.title: Strengthen net-edge guard in cross_chain_strategy_signals to require strictly positive net_edge_bps before emitting a signal
proposals.rationale: cross_chain_strategy_signals.py exposes a net_edge_bps property that can be zero or negative when costs exceed gross_edge_bps. Downstream callers are not all guarded by an explicit positive-net-edge check before acting on the signal. Adding a validated emit_signal helper that raises or returns None when net_edge_bps <= 0 closes the gap without altering any live execution path.

evidence.note: net_edge_bps computed as gross minus costs; no validator enforces >0 before signal emission

proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW mode feed MarketFeatures instances with net_edge_bps <= 0 (costs >= gross) and assert that the proposed guard prevents signal emission; assert that signals with net_edge_bps > MIN_EDGE_THRESHOLD do pass. Measure false-suppression rate against historical Solana and EVM shadow windows.

proposals.title: Add chain-specific latency_reserve_bps defaults to MarketFeatures to prevent EVM/Solana cost underestimation
proposals.rationale: MarketFeatures.latency_reserve_bps defaults to Decimal('0'). On Solana, MEV competition means a nonzero latency reserve is warranted; on EVM, gas price variance and block-time uncertainty similarly require a reserve. A chain-specific factory method or post-init validation that sets a minimum latency_reserve_bps per chain_type would reduce silent cost underestimation in shadow windows.

evidence.note: latency_reserve_bps defaults to Decimal('0') regardless of chain_type; no minimum is enforced

proposals.shadow_test: Create shadow windows on SOLANA and EVM with latency_reserve_bps=0 vs a calibrated minimum; compare net_profit distributions. Accept the change if mean net_edge_bps decreases by no more than 15% and the false-positive trade rate drops.

proposals.title: Require MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES before promoting a SHADOW strategy to PROMOTION_CANDIDATE
proposals.rationale: strategy_lab.py defines MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES=10 and MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION=0.20, but the promotion path in strategy_lab_research.py and shadow_strategy_executor.py should explicitly verify both thresholds before setting status to PROMOTION_CANDIDATE. Without this check, a strategy with few observed opportunities could be promoted on a small lucky sample.

evidence.note: MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES and MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION are defined but enforcement in promotion path needs explicit verification
promotion logic should gate on both eligible_opportunities and participation rate

proposals.shadow_test: Run SHADOW evaluation windows on a synthetic strategy where eligible_opportunities < MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES and assert status never reaches PROMOTION_CANDIDATE. Run a second window meeting all thresholds and assert promotion is permitted.

proposals.title: RESEARCH_MORE: collect multi-wallet cohort profitability evidence via Dune for liquidity-confirmed momentum hypothesis
proposals.rationale: The bot's strategy.py learn_patterns function builds route fingerprints from transaction history, but confidence and replicability scores have not been validated against an independent multi-wallet cohort on-chain. A Dune query over publicly observed DEX wallets that share the same route structure would either corroborate or refute the fingerprint-based confidence formula.

evidence.note: learn_patterns scores confidence from repeat_component + wallet_component + proof_component; no external cohort validation present

proposals.shadow_test: After collecting Dune cohort data for at least 3 independent wallets and 2 distinct time windows on both Solana and EVM, compare externally measured profit_factor against bot-computed confidence scores. Accept the formula if Spearman correlation > 0.6 out-of-sample.
proposals.research_plan: Query Dune public datasets for wallets executing the same DEX route fingerprints observed by the bot. Extract gross_profit, gross_loss, fee_paid per wallet per route. Compute external profit_factor. Cross-reference with bot strategy_patterns table.
